QuestInfo.0:
#e<Celestial Jackpot>#n

Cassandra is back with yet another special event! Spin the wheel to win big or lose it all! 

The wheel can be spun once every 30 mins. With every spin you'll land in one of two colors. Every time you land in black, you'll #bdouble your payout#k of Celestial Points. But land in white, and you'll lose your entire wager! Will luck be on your side?
